focused-tests.risk: The changed contract regresses its nearest executable unit or Swift harness.
focused-tests.trigger: Every code, test, matrix, layout, or semantics change with a mapped test group.
focused-tests.retirement: Replace only when an equivalent path-to-test selector preserves nearest-contract coverage.

scene-all-tests.risk: A shared Scene contract breaks a consumer outside the focused test group.
scene-all-tests.trigger: Milestone validation for Scene core, playback runner, Workshop bridge, or Scene playback input changes.
scene-all-tests.retirement: Retire only when dependency-aware coverage can prove the same cross-module risk with a smaller set.

code-health.risk: A Swift change adds a new oversized file or expands a locked legacy exception.
code-health.trigger: Swift changes when the selected build command does not already run code health.
code-health.retirement: Retire only if the compiler or another mandatory gate enforces the same file-size ratchet.

build-verify.risk: The product target no longer compiles or assembles its linked app and bundled resources.
build-verify.trigger: Checkpoint or later validation for product, project, or bundled resource changes.
build-verify.retirement: Replace only with a gate that builds the same product target and configuration; launch/runtime validation is a separate gate.

targeted-sample.risk: Executable unit coverage passes while the affected real Scene path is visually or structurally broken.
targeted-sample.trigger: Integration or milestone validation for Scene core, playback runner, Workshop bridge, or Scene playback input changes.
targeted-sample.retirement: Retire only when an equally representative reproducible runtime corpus becomes mandatory elsewhere.

matrix-tier-selection.risk: A matrix or benchmark contract change reaches milestone validation without declaring the corpus tier that must execute.
matrix-tier-selection.trigger: Milestone validation for matrix or benchmark contract changes without --matrix-tier.
matrix-tier-selection.retirement: Retire only when milestone tier selection is derived from an equally explicit reviewed contract.

fixed13.risk: A shared behavior regresses multiple stable representative samples.
fixed13.trigger: Milestone validation only when targeted evidence cannot cover the documented cross-sample risk.
fixed13.retirement: Retire when a reviewed representative suite supersedes fixed13 and preserves its regression role.

full45.risk: A sample-set, matrix, release, or broad shared-runtime change regresses the complete tracked corpus.
full45.trigger: Release, milestone, sample/matrix contract change, or an unexplained risk remaining after cheaper gates.
full45.retirement: Retire when the authoritative real-sample snapshot contract moves to a verified replacement gate.

scene-defense.risk: A Scene change adds a zero-caller entry, another copy of a canonical helper, or an error swallowed inside identity/digest computation.
scene-defense.trigger: Scene product paths change when the selected build command does not already run the defensive-surface ratchet.
scene-defense.retirement: Retire only if the compiler or another mandatory gate enforces the same defensive-surface ratchet.

design-gate.risk: Implementation of a registered capability starts before its design is approved.
design-gate.trigger: Product paths (including non-Swift Scene files), or Swift files change in any phase.
design-gate.retirement: Retire only when an equivalent mandatory gate enforces design approval before implementation; zero current hits do not retire this gate.

release-tests.risk: Release contracts outside the changed-path mapping regress.
release-tests.retirement: Retire when the test runner retires its explicit release scope.

all-tests.risk: A repository contract outside the changed-path mapping regresses.
all-tests.retirement: Retire when the test runner retires its explicit all scope.

unmapped-change.risk: A changed file escapes validation without a reviewed gate or exemption.
unmapped-change.trigger: A selected changed path has no executable mapping or explicit no-gate classification.
unmapped-change.retirement: Replace only when another mandatory selector rejects every unclassified changed path.

scene-structure.risk: A source owner, directory contract, structural family budget, or declared retirement state violates the frozen authority.
scene-structure.trigger: Scene product/layout or structural governance changes in inner and later phases.
scene-structure.retirement: Replace only with an equivalent mandatory gate preserving this contract and its negative cases.

document-links.risk: A Git-visible Markdown link or fragment points to a missing target.
document-links.trigger: Documentation or link-check governance changes in checkpoint and later phases.
document-links.retirement: Replace only with an equivalent mandatory gate preserving this contract and its negative cases.

test-assertions.risk: Tests add declaration-shape assertions in place of observable behavior coverage.
test-assertions.trigger: Python test modules, shape checker/baseline, or validation registry changes in any phase.
test-assertions.retirement: Replace only with an equivalent mandatory gate preserving this contract and its negative cases.

repository-artifacts.risk: Generated bulk enters Git-visible tool and documentation roots.
repository-artifacts.trigger: Changes within script/, docs/, .agents/, or .github/ in any phase.
repository-artifacts.retirement: Replace only when an equivalent mandatory tracked-artifact budget protects these roots without restricting product media.

scene-dependencies.risk: Rendering consumes new Compilation internals outside prepared contracts.
scene-dependencies.trigger: Scene Swift, dependency policy or any script/tests Python or Swift input changes; Python is scanned conservatively for embedded Swift.
scene-dependencies.retirement: Replace only with an equivalent deterministic check of the same authority and failure boundary.

document-health.risk: Current documents grow stale or regain historical payload, or permanent anchors are lost.
document-health.trigger: Documentation, role index or document lifecycle policy changes.
document-health.retirement: Replace only with an equivalent deterministic check of the same authority and failure boundary.

repository-residue.risk: Session artifacts become product sources or bundled resources.
repository-residue.trigger: Product sources, residue policy or repository governance changes.
repository-residue.retirement: Replace only with an equivalent deterministic check of the same authority and failure boundary.

app-debug-layout.risk: Debug-only sources drift into the App root or release compilation.
app-debug-layout.trigger: App Debug source or layout policy changes.
app-debug-layout.retirement: Replace only with equivalent compiler-backed directory and conditional-scope enforcement.
